free_tier.stated: A free student vServer: '1 vCPU', '1 GB DDR5', '10 GB NVMe', 'IPv4 address', 'IPv6 /64 block included', 'Monthly bandwidth 200 GB', 'Port speed 50 Mbit/s', full root SSH, web console and VNC. The home page states 'Cost · no card needed'.
free_tier.notes: registration is stopped on the day read; the shape is what the page advertises for when it reopens

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a virtual server, not an object

retention.stated: 'Renew each semester — 30-second re-verification every 6 months. Active learners can request extensions at any time.' No inactivity-deletion clock is published.
retention.notes: a six-month re-verification cadence, not an idle clock

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.tooling: Root SSH, web console, VNC, Docker allowed, distributions from Debian to Gentoo. /register returned a 500, so the signup path itself was not read.
record.chaining: Complements BoxyBSD inside one operator: BoxyBSD runs the BSD images, BoxedTux runs Ubuntu, Debian and Rocky, which is the distribution set most tooling assumes. The chain is closed because both halves need an affiliation: BoxyBSD needs a sponsor's invitation, BoxedTux needs an institution.

record.limits_note: Boxes run for 6-month terms with 'There isn't any grace-period! ... Expired boxes will be immediately deleted', so the term ends with no recovery window; but the eligibility gate, an institutional address, fails first.
record.binding_note: two gates stack: the account requires academic affiliation, and on the day read the registration form itself was closed for capacity

identity_cost.detail: 'Only academic email addresses are allowed. Not having an academic address? Contact us with proof of your student or educator status.' No card and no hold: the home page says 'Cost · no card needed'. This gate cannot be cleared at any price.

record.reliability_note: no reliability event observed; the home page advertises 99.7% uptime and names DDoS protection as optional.

record.notes: Worth recording rather than skipping: this is the best-specified free machine found in this class (1 GB DDR5, 10 GB NVMe, real IPv4, 200 GB traffic, 50 Mbit/s, root SSH) and it is entirely out of reach on two independent grounds. No academic affiliation, and a closed register. If the operator ever opens a non-academic programme the home page hints at ('running a non-profit or OSS project outside academia? reach out — separate program available'), the row would be worth re-testing.
